title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders Recovery Table — Retention Reserve on Takeover Installments
content:
For the member's repayment on an Orthodontic Benefit Riders takeover case, a retention reserve is held back from every takeover installment until appliance removal is reported. The reserve is a percentage of the takeover benefit:

| Appliance on the case | Reserve |
|---|---|
| fixed braces | 10 percent of the takeover benefit |
| clear aligners | 5 percent of the takeover benefit |
| limited or interceptive, or any other case | none |

The appliance type is read from the case's establishment entry.

*Hypothetical figures:* on a takeover benefit of 1,730.00, the reserve is 173.00 for fixed braces and 86.50 for clear aligners.
